resources.string: Insert a USB FIDO2 key, or hold an NFC key against your phone.
Waiting for the key. Touch it when requested; keep an NFC key against the phone.
Use at least %1$d characters and at most 63 UTF-8 bytes. Incorrect PIN attempts can block the key.
This passkey will be generated inside your security key. Confirm, then touch the key when requested.
Use the passkey in your security key to sign in to this site or app.
On Android 14 or later, enable Monica as a passkey provider. Add a passkey on the site, then choose Monica’s physical security key option in the system dialog.
Existing Monica private keys cannot be imported into a standard FIDO2 key. PINs and hardware credentials are not saved in Monica.
Generate the new passkey in a USB or NFC key
Sign in using a USB or NFC key
Website and app registration requires Android 14 or later.
This request could not be verified or contains unsupported options. Return to the site and try another registration option.
USB access was not granted. Find the key again to retry.
No suitable USB key found. Check the connection and USB OTG support.
Several USB HID devices are connected. Leave only the security key you want to use.
The new PIN does not meet the key’s length or encoding requirements.
Incorrect PIN. No automatic retry was made. Check the PIN before trying again.
The key has blocked PIN attempts. Follow its manufacturer’s instructions; Monica will not reset the key.
This account already has a credential on this key.
No matching credential found on this key.
The security key has no free credential slots.
The key cancelled the operation or the touch timed out. Reconnect to retry.
The key could not complete the operation. Check its PIN, capabilities and connection, then reconnect if needed.
